## Description
Plagioclase feldspars &#10;&#9;  (sodium–calcium solid solution): ranging from Albite (NaAlSi₃O₈) to Anorthite (CaAl₂Si₂O₈) &#10;&#9;  &#10;&#9;  Feldspars occur in all major rock types (igneous, metamorphic, and sedimentary) and are the &#10;&#9;  primary ingredient in ceramics, glass, and enamel. When they weather, they break down into &#10;&#9;  clay minerals (e.g., kaolinite), which is how most soils form. &#10;&#9;
